# aeneid-098 — run lead's corrections to the glosser's gloss.json

- `ereptum`: the glosser made it neuter with *ensem* "understood"; *ensis* is masculine and *ereptum* agrees with *ensem* in 798–799. Corrected to m. acc. sg.
- `pinnae`, `puniceae`: the glosser parsed them nom. pl.; at 750 *puniceae… formidine pinnae* is genitive singular (the feather-scare). Corrected.
- `excisurum`: "with Aenean understood" replaced by the future infinitive with *esse* and *sē* understood (Aeneas threatens that he will raze the city).
- `mortalin`: the glosser made it a nom. sg. noun; at 797 *mortali… volnere* is n. abl. sg. Corrected.
- `edit`: at 801 *ni te… edit* is the old present subjunctive (= *edat*), not the indicative. Corrected.
